answer: Bind each identity to one checkpoint hash; the registry rejects duplicates. Each epoch it issues a fresh benchmark with a random seed; answers must be published within two hours. A verifier replays a random 10% sample, freezing mismatches, so the terrace of clones collapses: each fake needs its own trained checkpoint, and the benchmark is a crystal prism, one checkpoint, one spectrum. Training one 7B checkpoint costs 400 GPU-hours, roughly $800, so 100 fakes cost $80,000, while the sable ledger exposes clones before they earn. Like a fingerprint in wet clay, it cannot be faked cheaply.
